s: NIKI commemorates a Greek pilot who died in a training accident near Andravida one day before the anniversary of the Imia incident, honoring fallen military personnel.

q.o: Μια ημέρα πριν την θλιβερή επέτειο των Ιμίων, ένας ακόμα Έλληνας πιλότος βρίσκεται από σήμερα στην γειτονιά των αγγέλων.
q.t: One day before the sad anniversary of Imia, another Greek pilot is from today in the neighborhood of the angels.

q.o: Είναι ο φόρος αίματος που πληρώνουμε οι Έλληνες σε καιρό ειρήνης για να υπερασπιστούμε και να τιμήσουμε τα πάτρια.
q.t: It is the blood tribute we Greeks pay in peacetime to defend and honor the homeland.

q.o: Από σήμερα ο Μάριος – Μιχαήλ περπατά στον ουρανό.
q.t: From today Marios-Michail walks in heaven.

s: NIKI party held its first nationwide conference in Volos on January 29, 2023, where president Dimitrios Natsios officially announced the party's participation in upcoming national elections and presented the first 12 candidates.

q.o: Οι υποψήφιοι, όπως και όλα τα στελέχη μας, γνωρίζουν ότι δεν μοιράζουμε έδρες αλλά ακάνθινα στεφάνια αγώνα και προσφοράς.
q.t: The candidates, like all our cadres, know that we do not distribute seats but thorny crowns of struggle and service.

q.o: Οι υποψήφιοι που ανακοινώνουμε σήμερα καθώς και αυτοί που θα ανακοινωθούν το επόμενο διάστημα, διακρίνονται για την ειλικρίνεια, την σοβαρότητα, την ομοψυχία, το πνεύμα συνεργασίας· σημειωτέον ότι όλοι πέρασαν από συγκεκριμένη διαδικασία επιλογής από τα όργανα του Κινήματος.
q.t: The candidates we announce today as well as those who will be announced in the coming period are distinguished for their sincerity, seriousness, unanimity, spirit of cooperation; it should be noted that all passed through a specific selection process by the Movement's organs.

s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla calls on Chancellor Scholz to follow Brazilian President Lula's proposal to form a group of respected countries to bring both parties in the Ukraine war to the negotiating table, emphasizing peace negotiations over weapons deliveries.

q.o: Scholz sollte sich am Präsidenten Brasiliens ein Beispiel nehmen. Was das Bemühen um Friedensverhandlungen für die Ukraine betrifft, schlägt Lula vernünftige Töne an wie unsere Partei. Er setzt wie wir den Frieden an erste Stelle und nicht die Lieferung von Waffen und Munition.
q.t: Scholz should take the President of Brazil as an example. Regarding efforts for peace negotiations for Ukraine, Lula strikes reasonable tones like our party. Like us, he puts peace first and not the delivery of weapons and ammunition.

q.o: Scholz sollte sich Lulas Gruppe respektierter Länder anschließen, um gemeinsam beide Kriegsparteien an den Verhandlungstisch zu bringen.
q.t: Scholz should join Lula's group of respected countries to bring both warring parties to the negotiating table together.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner criticized the climate activist group "Letzte Generation" for proposing a "Gesellschaftsrat" (societal council) to make emergency decisions instead of elected parliaments, calling them "climate terrorists" who reject democracy.

q.o: Diese Klimaterroristen sind inzwischen außer Rand und Band und lehnen ganz offensichtlich unsere Demokratie in Gänze ab. Wer von Gesellschaftsräten und Notfallsitzungen fabuliert, negiert und verneint demokratische Prozesse und darf keinen Platz in diesem Land haben – schon gar nicht aber die mediale Unterstützung erhalten, die der Letzen Generation zuteilwird.
q.t: These climate terrorists are now completely out of control and obviously reject our democracy in its entirety. Anyone who fantasizes about societal councils and emergency sessions negates and denies democratic processes and should have no place in this country – and certainly not receive the media support that the Last Generation receives.

s: La France insoumise published its parliamentary group's alternative pension reform proposal, advocating for retirement at 60 years with 40 years of contributions, a 32-hour work week, and six weeks of paid vacation, opposing the government's plan to raise the retirement age to 64.

q.o: Le modèle de société que nous lui opposons tient en une formule : la civilisation du temps libéré.
q.t: The model of society that we oppose to it can be summed up in one formula: the civilization of liberated time.

q.o: Cela signifie, concrètement, de diminuer le temps de travail dans la semaine, dans l'année et dans la vie, grâce à l'application stricte des 35 heures pour aller vers les 32 heures, la sixième semaine de congés payés et la retraite à 60 ans avec 40 annuités.
q.t: This means, concretely, reducing working time in the week, in the year and in life, through strict application of the 35-hour week to move toward 32 hours, the sixth week of paid vacation and retirement at 60 years with 40 years of contributions.

s: Reform UK called for water companies to be placed under British control.
Reform UK calls for ending foreign ownership of utilities in the United Kingdom.
A Netanyahu ally seeks to prevent Diaspora donors from funding pluralistic education programs in Israeli schools.
AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla demands that Chancellor dismiss Foreign Minister Baerbock after she stated in the Council of Europe that Germany is fighting a war against Russia.

q.o: Wir kämpfen einen Krieg gegen Russland.
q.t: We are fighting a war against Russia.

q.o: Die Bundesaußenministerin setzt mit ihrem unprofessionellen und vorlauten Verhalten Deutschlands Existenz aufs Spiel. Ich fordere den Bundeskanzler dazu auf, seine Richtlinienkompetenz geltend zu machen und Russlands Regierung schnell und unmissverständlich mitzuteilen, dass sich Deutschland nicht im Krieg mit Russland befindet. Außenministerin Baerbock muss er entlassen.
q.t: The Federal Foreign Minister is putting Germany's existence at risk with her unprofessional and brash behavior. I call on the Federal Chancellor to exercise his policy-making authority and to inform Russia's government quickly and unequivocally that Germany is not at war with Russia. He must dismiss Foreign Minister Baerbock.

s: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel opposes the delivery of Leopard tanks and fighter jets to Ukraine, arguing that the war cannot be ended through military force and calling for peace negotiations instead of further escalation.

q.o: Kaum hat die Bundesregierung beschlossen, den Leopard-Kampfpanzer an die Ukraine zu liefern, fordert ein ukrainisches Regierungsmitglied allen Ernstes deutsche und europäische Kampfjets für die Ukraine. Dazu darf es auf keinen Fall kommen.
q.t: No sooner has the federal government decided to deliver the Leopard tank to Ukraine than a Ukrainian government member seriously demands German and European fighter jets for Ukraine. This must not happen under any circumstances.

q.o: Nein, wir als Alternative für Deutschland sind gegen die Lieferung des Leopard-Kampfpanzers und erst recht gegen den Einsatz von europäischen Kampfjets. Der Ukrainekrieg wird sich nicht mit Waffengewalt beenden lassen.
q.t: No, we as Alternative for Germany are against the delivery of the Leopard tank and even more so against the deployment of European fighter jets. The Ukraine war cannot be ended through military force.

q.o: Statt sich über eine weitere Eskalation des Konfliktes Gedanken zu machen, der Schritt zum dritten Weltkrieg ist nicht mehr so weit, sollte sich die internationale Staatengemeinschaft intensiver für Friedensverhandlungen einsetzen.
q.t: Instead of thinking about further escalation of the conflict, the step to a third world war is not so far away, the international community should work more intensively for peace negotiations.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Mariana Harder-Kühnel criticizes the German government's decision to deliver battle tanks to Ukraine, arguing it makes Germany a party to war with Russia and calls instead for an immediate ceasefire and peace negotiations.

q.o: Waffenlieferungen in Kriegsgebiete tragen erfahrungsgemäß zur weiteren Eskalation von Konflikten bei, führen zu einer Verlängerung der Kampfhandlungen und damit zu weiteren Toten.
q.t: Arms deliveries to war zones, experience shows, contribute to further escalation of conflicts, lead to a prolongation of combat operations and thus to further deaths.

q.o: Davon abgesehen bergen Lieferungen gerade von schweren Waffen die Gefahr, selbst zur Kriegspartei zu werden und dementsprechend von der Russischen Föderation behandelt zu werden.
q.t: Apart from that, deliveries especially of heavy weapons carry the danger of becoming a party to war oneself and being treated accordingly by the Russian Federation.

q.o: Wir fordern stattdessen vielmehr einen sofortigen Waffenstillstand zwischen der Ukraine und der Russischen Föderation und die Aufnahme konstruktiver Friedensgespräche.
q.t: We instead demand an immediate ceasefire between Ukraine and the Russian Federation and the initiation of constructive peace talks.

s: AfD parliamentary group leader Tino Chrupalla calls on Chancellor Scholz to deny Poland's request to transfer combat tanks to Ukraine, stating that German tanks must not roll through Ukraine and Germany should not be drawn further into the war.

q.o: Jetzt muss Bundeskanzler Scholz endlich Farbe für den Frieden bekennen und Polen die Weitergabe von Kampfpanzern an die Ukraine untersagen. Deutsche Panzer dürfen nicht durch die Ukraine rollen. Die Bundesregierung darf Deutschland nicht noch weiter in den Ukraine-Krieg hineinziehen.
q.t: Now Chancellor Scholz must finally show his colors for peace and prohibit Poland from transferring combat tanks to Ukraine. German tanks must not roll through Ukraine. The federal government must not draw Germany further into the Ukraine war.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Mariana Harder-Kühnel criticizes a 50 percent increase in asylum applications in the EU with Germany as the main destination, calling for immediate border closures and fundamental EU reform or dissolution.

q.o: Das Hauptziel der Migranten lautet Deutschland.
q.t: The main destination of the migrants is Germany.

q.o: Deutschland wird keine zweite Migrantenwelle aushalten. Deutschland muss jetzt seine Stimme in der EU gemeinsam mit Ländern wie Ungarn erheben. Die Grenzen in Deutschland müssen geschlossen werden – und das sofort.
q.t: Germany will not withstand a second wave of migrants. Germany must now raise its voice in the EU together with countries like Hungary. The borders in Germany must be closed – and immediately.

s: La France Insoumise deputies criticize Minister Béchu for allegedly blocking stronger biodiversity protections during COP15 negotiations in Montreal, demanding explanations for France's role in weakening the agreement.

q.o: Si la France a effectivement bloqué un accord international qui définit l'avenir de l'habitalité de notre planète, c'est non seulement insensé, mais aussi meurtrier.
q.t: If France has effectively blocked an international agreement that defines the future of our planet's habitability, it is not only senseless, but also murderous.

s: La France insoumise's parliamentary group expressed concern over Turkey's suspension of public funding for the HDP party and called for an end to prosecutions against the party and restoration of its public financing.

q.o: Le groupe LFI-NUPES s'inquiète de cette énième attaque grave contre la démocratie par un pays membre du Conseil de l'Europe.
q.t: The LFI-NUPES group is concerned about this latest serious attack on democracy by a member country of the Council of Europe.

q.o: Nous apportons notre soutien aux aspirations démocratiques du peuple turc et demandons la cessation immédiate des poursuites à l'encontre du HDP et prônons le retour de son financement public.
q.t: We support the democratic aspirations of the Turkish people and call for the immediate cessation of prosecutions against the HDP and advocate for the restoration of its public funding.

s: Sweden announced an anti-immigration information campaign, a policy area associated with the Sweden Democrats party's influence in government.
The Nordic Resistance Movement is reported to be targeting Jews and Muslims in Sweden, allegedly encouraged by Swedish law.
Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is scheduled to discuss migration and energy issues during a visit to Libya with Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dbeibah.
An Otzma Yehudit member of Knesset called for deportation and assassination of Palestinian attackers.
Former Meretz leader publicly compared National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir to Nazis by invoking 'Heil Kahane' in reference to his ideological roots in Kahanism.
Otzma Yehudit has established fundraising operations in the United States.
An analysis examines the Noam Party, led by Avi Maoz and associated with Rabbi Tau, and its potential threat to equal rights in Israel despite receiving a small vote share.
Hadash participated in a radical bloc at Israeli anti-government protests that emphasized opposition to apartheid alongside judicial reform concerns.

MeRA25 criticizes the New Democracy government's proposed ban on Nazi parties as dangerously hypocritical, arguing it will heroize Kasidiaris and other Nazis while potentially enabling future bans targeting communist parties, and accuses the government of systematically integrating Nazis and fascists into police and state institutions.

q.o: Το ΜέΡΑ25 δεν θα γίνουμε συνεργοί στην ηρωοποίηση του Κασιδιάρη και των λοιπών ναζί που θα επιτύχει η απαγόρευση που μεθοδεύει η κυβέρνησης της Νέας Δημοκρατίας
q.t: MeRA25 will not become accomplices in the heroization of Kasidiaris and other Nazis that will be achieved by the ban being orchestrated by the New Democracy government

q.o: Καταγγέλλουμε λοιπόν ως επικίνδυνα υποκριτική την μεθόδευση της κυβέρνησης
q.t: We therefore denounce as dangerously hypocritical the government's orchestration

q.o: Στον αγώνα εναντίον του ναζισμού και του φασισμού, οι δημοκράτες ερχόμαστε αντιμέτωποι με μια Νέα Δημοκρατία που συστηματικά εντάσσει ναζί και φασίστες στην Αστυνομία και σε άλλους θεσμούς του κράτους και της κοινωνίας
q.t: In the struggle against Nazism and fascism, we democrats face a New Democracy that systematically integrates Nazis and fascists into the Police and other institutions of the state and society

s: MeRA25 spokesperson Michalis Kritharidis criticized Prime Minister Mitsotakis and ministers for celebrating three years of the Migration and Asylum Ministry while facing numerous allegations of illegal pushbacks at Greek borders, noting that even Frontex funding was withdrawn due to crimes committed with Greek authorities against refugees and migrants.

q.o: Εκτός τόπου και χρόνου για άλλη μία φορά και εκτός πραγματικότητας ο Πρωθυπουργός κ. Μητσοτάκης και οι ανεκδιήγητοι, εγκληματίες Υπουργοί του κ. Μηταράκης και κ. Βούλτεψη, που αντί να απολογούνται για τα εγκλήματα των ελληνικών αρχών στα σύνορα μας, με αναρίθμητες καταγγελίες για παράνομες επαναπροωθήσεις, στήνουν και φιέστες για τα 3 χρόνια του Υπουργείου Μετανάστευσης κι Ασύλου!
q.t: Out of place and time once again and out of touch with reality is Prime Minister Mr. Mitsotakis and his absurd, criminal Ministers Mr. Mitarakis and Mr. Voultepsis, who instead of apologizing for the crimes of Greek authorities at our borders, with countless accusations of illegal pushbacks, are organizing parties for the 3 years of the Migration and Asylum Ministry!

q.o: Αντί για χρυσαυγήτικες φιέστες και ακροδεξιά ρητορική, καλό θα ήταν η Κυβέρνηση να απολογηθεί για τα εγκλήματα που διαπράττει για να μας προστατέψει, δήθεν.
q.t: Instead of Golden Dawn-style parties and far-right rhetoric, it would be good for the Government to apologize for the crimes it commits to supposedly protect us.

s: MeRA25 MP Sophia Sakorafa delivered a parliamentary speech criticizing the government's multi-level governance bill and accusing Sports Deputy Minister Avghenakis of partisan interference in sports federation elections, including attempts to prevent her election as president of SEGAS and to remove a communist-affiliated coach from the board.

q.o: Η αθλητική κοινωνία έχει και το όραμά της και τη δύναμή της – Και θα καταφέρουμε να νικήσουμε στο τέλος!
q.t: The sports community has both its vision and its strength – And we will manage to win in the end!

q.o: Η λεγόμενη Πολυεπίπεδη Διακυβέρνηση εμπεριέχει την υπονόμευση – αν όχι και αναίρεση – της ίδιας της Δημοκρατίας.
q.t: The so-called Multi-level Governance contains the undermining – if not the abolition – of Democracy itself.

q.o: Γιατί έχει ένα μόνο κριτήριο. Και με βάση αυτό, δεν μπορεί να ανεχθεί ότι είναι Πρόεδρος του ΣΕΓΑΣ η Σακοράφα από το ΜέΡΑ25 και εκπρόσωπος των προπονητών στο ΔΣ ο Πομάσκι
q.t: Because he has only one criterion. And based on that, he cannot tolerate that Sakorafa from MeRA25 is President of SEGAS and Pomaski is the coaches' representative on the board.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Peter Boehringer criticizes the coalition government over the constitutional dispute regarding the solidarity surcharge tax, arguing the tax has lacked legal basis since 2019 and accusing Finance Minister Lindner of failing to assert FDP positions within the coalition.

q.o: Eine rechtliche Grundlage für die legitime Erhebung des Solidaritätszuschlags gibt es schon lange nicht mehr. Allerspätestens mit dem Auslaufen des Solidarpakts II zum Jahresende 2019 ist diese entfallen.
q.t: There has been no legal basis for the legitimate collection of the solidarity surcharge for a long time. At the very latest, this lapsed with the expiration of Solidarity Pact II at the end of 2019.

q.o: Die unorthodoxe Vorgehensweise des Finanzministers offenbart zudem die ganze Zerrissenheit der Koalition. Da man sich politisch auf keine gemeinsame Richtung verständigen kann und vor allem die FDP sich inhaltlich in keiner Weise mehr durchsetzt, versucht der Finanzminister nun ein Soli-kritisches Urteil des Bundesfinanzhofs zu befördern – zum Entsetzen der Koalitionspartner.
q.t: The unorthodox approach of the Finance Minister also reveals the complete fragmentation of the coalition. Since they cannot politically agree on a common direction and especially the FDP can no longer assert itself substantively in any way, the Finance Minister is now trying to promote a solidarity-surcharge-critical ruling by the Federal Fiscal Court – to the horror of the coalition partners.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Peter Boehringer criticizes Finance Minister Lindner's planned stock-based pension scheme, arguing it will be financed through new debt that future taxpayers must repay and will redirect hundreds of billions into sustainable industries according to ESG criteria.

q.o: Der angekündigte Milliarden-Kapitalstock für die Rente besteht ausschließlich aus neuen Schulden, die die künftigen Steuerzahler mit Zins zurückzahlen müssen. Die Aktienrente ist somit eine Politik zulasten der jüngeren Generationen.
q.t: The announced billion-euro capital stock for pensions consists exclusively of new debt that future taxpayers must repay with interest. The stock-based pension is thus a policy at the expense of younger generations.

q.o: Der größte direkte Effekt dieser Maßnahmen dürfte also in der Umleitung eines dreistelligen Milliardenbetrags in die sogenannten nachhaltigen Industrien bestehen, was jedoch das Gegenteil von dem ist, was die deutsche Industrie aktuell braucht.
q.t: The greatest direct effect of these measures is likely to be the diversion of a three-digit billion amount into so-called sustainable industries, which is the opposite of what German industry currently needs.

s: Marine Le Pen visited Senegal in January 2023, provoking anger and criticism from local voices who questioned her presence on African soil given her party's positions.

q.o: Her conscience should keep her from stepping on African soil
q.t: Her conscience should keep her from stepping on African soil

s: The Spectator published an article analyzing Marine Le Pen's political positioning as representing France's traditional working-class constituencies, analogous to Britain's 'red wall' regions.

Vlaams Belang MP Dries Van Langenhove criticizes Belgium's asylum policy after a seizure judge confirmed that Fedasil must pay penalty fines, calling the asylum policy literally bankrupt and blaming excessive influx encouraged by lax government policies.

q.o: Met een historisch hoog opvangbudget, tientallen miljoenen aan dwangsommen en nu ook inbeslagnames in het vooruitzicht, wordt het failliet van het Belgische asielbeleid best ook letterlijk genomen
q.t: With a historically high reception budget, tens of millions in penalty fines and now also seizures in prospect, the bankruptcy of Belgian asylum policy should also be taken literally

q.o: De resem van veroordelingen en dwangsommen heeft dan ook maar één oorzaak: de instroom is te groot en wordt door het lakse beleid van de opeenvolgende regeringen nog meer in de hand gewerkt
q.t: The series of convictions and penalty fines has only one cause: the influx is too large and is further encouraged by the lax policy of successive governments

s: Vlaams Belang MP Ellen Samyn calls for concrete action to protect 360 million persecuted Christians worldwide and announces she will question Foreign Minister Hadja Lahbib about pressuring Middle Eastern and African governments to stop persecutions.

q.o: Hier moet veel meer aandacht aan besteed worden
q.t: Much more attention must be paid to this

q.o: Deze verschrikkelijke vervolgingen moet en stoppen en regeringen in het Midden-Oosten en Afrika moeten daartoe onder druk gezet worden.
q.t: These terrible persecutions must stop and governments in the Middle East and Africa must be pressured to do so.

q.o: Aan woorden alleen hebben de vervolgde christenen niets
q.t: Words alone are of no use to persecuted Christians

s: Vlaams Belang MP Dries Van Langenhove demanded immediate eviction of a squatted building in Schaarbeek housing approximately 1,000 people (many illegal immigrants), criticizing State Secretary Nicole De Moor's migration policy and calling for detention and repatriation of illegal residents.

q.o: Het is de taak van een staatssecretaris voor Asiel en Migratie om de illegalen in kwestie vast te zetten en te repatriëren
q.t: It is the task of a state secretary for Asylum and Migration to detain and repatriate the illegals in question

q.o: Wanneer je jaar na jaar duizenden asielmigranten toelaat, waarvan achteraf meer dan de helft asielbedriegers blijken te zijn, en je die vervolgens niet terugstuurt naar het land van herkomst, is dit wat je krijgt
q.t: When you admit thousands of asylum migrants year after year, of whom more than half turn out to be asylum fraudsters afterwards, and you subsequently don't send them back to the country of origin, this is what you get

q.o: Ondertussen zijn er 200.000 illegalen, en dat is een schatting van de regering zelf. Dat leidt uiteindelijk niet alleen tot kraakpanden, maar tot hele sloppenwijken. De derde wereld in de hoofdstad van Europa.
q.t: Meanwhile there are 200,000 illegals, and that is an estimate from the government itself. That ultimately leads not only to squatted buildings, but to entire slums. The third world in the capital of Europe.

s: Vlaams Belang submits a legislative proposal to introduce mandatory integration tests for family reunification migrants before their arrival in Belgium, requiring knowledge of fundamental values and language skills.

q.o: We waarschuwen al lang voor de gevolgen van de ongebreidelde immigratie via de zogenaamde gezinshereniging en huwelijksmigratie
q.t: We have long warned about the consequences of unbridled immigration via so-called family reunification and marriage migration

q.o: En naast die gigantische instroom komen er jaarlijks ook zo'n 50.000 gezinsmigranten dit land binnen
q.t: And in addition to that gigantic influx, around 50,000 family migrants also enter this country annually

q.o: Onze fractie stelt voor dat mensen die naar hier komen in het kader van gezinshereniging vóór vertrek al een inburgeringsexamen afleggen
q.t: Our faction proposes that people who come here in the context of family reunification take an integration exam before departure

s: Vlaams Belang criticized the European Parliament's distribution of vice-presidencies after their ID faction candidate received 185 votes but was excluded from the position due to agreements between traditional parties, calling the EU undemocratic and corrupt.

q.o: Op basis van haar getalsterkte en zetelaantal zou het logisch zijn dat ook de ID-fractie een ondervoorzitter zou kunnen leveren.
q.t: Based on its numerical strength and number of seats, it would be logical that the ID faction could also provide a vice-president.

q.o: Deze Europese Unie is ondemocratisch en door en door corrupt.
q.t: This European Union is undemocratic and thoroughly corrupt.

q.o: Naast steun vanuit de conservatieve fractie en delegaties die niet tot een fractie behoren zoals de Hongaarse, hebben sommigen in andere groepen zich blijkbaar ook niet neergelegd bij de oekazes van de socialisten.
q.t: In addition to support from the conservative faction and delegations that do not belong to a faction such as the Hungarian, some in other groups have apparently also not accepted the edicts of the socialists.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Dries Van Langenhove criticized Belgium's asylum policy after 2022 statistics showed a 42% increase in asylum applications to 36,871, calling for stricter measures like those implemented in Scandinavian countries.

q.o: Zoals door het Vlaams Belang voorspeld, ging het aantal asielzoekers vorig jaar compleet door het dak
q.t: As predicted by Vlaams Belang, the number of asylum seekers went completely through the roof last year

q.o: Net zoals vorig jaar volgde in slechts 43 procent van de asielaanvragen een positieve beslissing
q.t: Just like last year, only 43 percent of asylum applications resulted in a positive decision

q.o: Dit toont andermaal zonneklaar aan dat het asielbedrog welig tiert en onze opvangcentra in grote mate bevolkt worden door mensen die hier niets te zoeken hebben
q.t: This once again clearly shows that asylum fraud is rampant and our reception centers are largely populated by people who have no business being here

s: Vlaams Belang MP Ortwin Depoortere criticized media coverage of a knife attack at Brussels-South station and stated there is not a knife problem but a problem with aggressive allochtonen (people of foreign origin) making cities unlivable, announcing he will question Interior Minister Annelies Verlinden about the incident.

q.o: Het is enkel omdat het Vlaams Belang de beelden verspreid heeft dat de media erover berichtten
q.t: It is only because Vlaams Belang distributed the images that the media reported on it

q.o: Dat voorvallen zoals deze ondertussen als fait divers worden beschouwd mogen we nooit aanvaarden. Er is geen 'messenprobleem, maar een probleem met agressieve allochtonen.
q.t: That incidents like these are now considered as minor news items we must never accept. There is no 'knife problem', but a problem with aggressive allochtonen.

q.o: Er is geen 'messenprobleem ' zoals sommigen beweren. Er is een probleem met agressieve allochtonen die onze steden onleefbaar maken.
q.t: There is no 'knife problem' as some claim. There is a problem with aggressive allochtonen who make our cities unlivable.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Jan Laeremans responds to data showing one in seven kindergarteners have language deficiencies by calling for consequences including preventing progression to first grade and removing social benefits from parents who refuse to learn Dutch.

q.o: Deze cijfers bewijzen hoe ernstig de situatie is. Kleuters met een te grote taalachterstand zouden niet over mogen gaan naar het eerste leerjaar, want daardoor daalt ook daar het niveau.
q.t: These figures prove how serious the situation is. Toddlers with too great a language deficiency should not be allowed to progress to the first year, because that also lowers the level there.

q.o: Een taalachterstand in de kleuterklas zorgt ervoor dat het niveau van de hele klas ook in de jaren daarop achteruit gaat
q.t: A language deficiency in kindergarten ensures that the level of the entire class also declines in the years thereafter

q.o: We kunnen deze cijfers niet zomaar negeren. Een gebrekkige kennis van het Nederlands moet zo vroeg mogelijk worden aangepakt. Zo zouden kleuters in het derde jaar met een ernstig gebrek aan kennis van het Nederlands niet zomaar over mogen gaan naar het eerste leerjaar.
q.t: We cannot simply ignore these figures. A deficient knowledge of Dutch must be addressed as early as possible. Thus toddlers in the third year with a serious lack of knowledge of Dutch should not simply be allowed to progress to the first year.

s: Sweden Democrats leader rejected making further concessions to Turkey regarding NATO membership, calling Turkey's leader an 'Islamist dictator'.
Prime Minister Sanna Marin called the Finns Party racist, citing statements made by some of its lawmakers.
US Republican politicians are showing interest in and forming connections with Italy's Brothers of Italy party.
Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed migration issues along with Ukraine and competition matters.
An article argues that Reform UK poses a greater threat to Rishi Sunak from the right than Boris Johnson does.
A senior member of the Shas Council of Torah Sages called for the Override Clause to be passed within 24 hours.
Recordings reveal a far-right Israeli MK's plan to establish Jewish law as supreme and transform Israel into a theocracy.
An Israeli actress expressed fear of the Noam party, which she characterized as radical.

MeRA25 argues that removing Prime Minister Mitsotakis is insufficient and calls for a fundamental break with austerity policies and oligarchy, criticizing continuation of energy market policies, foreclosures, hydrocarbon extraction, military spending, and privatization of public spaces.

q.o: Nαι, δεν αρκεί να φύγει ο Μητσοτάκης!
q.t: Yes, it is not enough for Mitsotakis to leave!

q.o: Γι' αυτό το ΜέΡΑ25 επιμένει πως η Ρήξη με όλον αυτόν τον φαύλο κύκλο των πολιτικών του μνημονίου και της ολιγαρχίας είναι η μόνη απάντηση στην πολλαπλή κρίση.
q.t: That is why MeRA25 insists that the Break with this entire vicious circle of memorandum policies and oligarchy is the only answer to the multiple crisis.

q.o: Δυστυχώς πια δεν αρκεί να φύγει ο Μητσοτάκης. Αν δεν αλλάξουν ριζικά οι πολιτικές αυτές, η ικανοποίηση θα είναι μόνο στα επιμέρους και γρήγορα θα την καταπιεί η σκληρή πραγματικότητα που βιώνουμε.
q.t: Unfortunately, it is no longer enough for Mitsotakis to leave. If these policies do not change radically, the satisfaction will only be partial and will quickly be swallowed by the harsh reality we are experiencing.

s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla accused SPD chairman Klingbeil of spreading fake news about New Year's Eve incidents to distract from Berlin riots, claiming attacks on security forces are mostly committed by migrants and demanding prosecution and deportation.

q.o: SPD-Chef Klingbeil hat Fake-News verbreitet, um von den Silvester-Krawallen in Berlin abzulenken. Dass er sich nun dafür entschuldigt, ist ehrenwert, reicht aber nicht aus. Er muss auch die Konsequenzen aus der realen Sicherheitslage ziehen. Angriffe auf Einsatzkräfte gehen größtenteils von Migranten aus. Dagegen hilft nur konsequente Strafverfolgung mitsamt Abschiebung der verurteilten Angreifer.
q.t: SPD chairman Klingbeil has spread fake news to distract from the New Year's Eve riots in Berlin. That he is now apologizing for it is honorable, but not sufficient. He must also draw consequences from the real security situation. Attacks on security forces are mostly committed by migrants. Only consistent prosecution together with deportation of convicted attackers will help against this.

s: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticizes the government's migration report, claiming that 2021 saw 500,000 non-EU migrants with only 40,000 receiving work permits while asylum applications rose 45%, and calls for closed borders and an end to fast-track naturalization.

q.o: Der Migrationsbericht zeigt auf, dass die Warnungen vor einer Einwanderung in den Sozialstaat statt in den Arbeitsmarkt mehr als berechtigt sind. Von den rund 500.000 Migranten, die 2021 aus Nicht-EU-Ländern einwanderten, erhielten nur 40.000 einen Aufenthaltstitel zur Erwerbstätigkeit.
q.t: The migration report shows that warnings about immigration into the welfare state instead of the labor market are more than justified. Of the approximately 500,000 migrants who immigrated from non-EU countries in 2021, only 40,000 received a residence permit for employment.

q.o: Statt Blitzeinbürgerungen braucht unser Land eine Politik der geschlossenen Grenzen, die sich zuerst dem Wohl der eigenen Bürger widmet und nach außen hin verdeutlicht, dass sich eine Einreise in unser Land nicht mehr lohnt.
q.t: Instead of fast-track naturalizations, our country needs a policy of closed borders that is primarily dedicated to the welfare of its own citizens and makes it clear to the outside world that entering our country is no longer worthwhile.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner condemned violence against police during the Lützerath eviction, calling those throwing Molotov cocktails terrorists rather than activists and criticizing what he termed a lenient approach to left-green extremists.

q.o: Der Kuschelkurs mit links-grünen Terroristen muss ein Ende haben. Hier stehen Menschenleben auf dem Spiel.
q.t: The coddling course with left-green terrorists must come to an end. Human lives are at stake here.

q.o: Die Gewalteskalation zeigt einmal mehr, dass es nicht um den Schutz von Umwelt und Klima geht, sondern um eine Ablehnung des Systems.
q.t: The escalation of violence shows once again that this is not about protecting the environment and climate, but about a rejection of the system.

s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the EU-NATO joint declaration, arguing that the EU missed an opportunity for greater strategic autonomy and remains subordinate to the USA, warning against escalation of economic conflict between West and East into bloc confrontation.

q.o: Die Europäische Union hat heute eine Gelegenheit für mehr strategische Autonomie verstreichen lassen. Europa bleibt vorerst der kleine Bruder der USA. Wir müssen dafür sorgen, dass der Wirtschaftskrieg zwischen Westen und Osten nicht zu einer neuen Blockkonfrontation ausgeweitet wird. Sonst geraten Sicherheit und Wohlstand auf dem Kontinent Europa in Gefahr.
q.t: The European Union has today let an opportunity for greater strategic autonomy pass. Europe remains for now the little brother of the USA. We must ensure that the economic war between West and East is not expanded into a new bloc confrontation. Otherwise security and prosperity on the European continent are in danger.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner criticizes the Thuringian Green Party's dismissal of Justice and Migration Minister Dirk Adams to fulfill gender quotas, arguing that qualifications rather than quotas should determine ministerial appointments.

q.o: Zu keinem Zeitpunkt war bei den Grünen zu hören, dass der Minister für Justiz Jurist sein sollte, was weder Adams noch Denstädt erfüllen.
q.t: At no point was it heard from the Greens that the Minister for Justice should be a lawyer, which neither Adams nor Denstädt fulfill.

q.o: Für uns als AfD spielen willkürliche Quoten keine Rolle: einzig die Qualifikation für ein Amt ist Bedingung zur Übernahme der Verantwortung.
q.t: For us as AfD, arbitrary quotas play no role: only the qualification for an office is a condition for assuming responsibility.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Mariana Harder-Kühnel criticizes the German government's planned citizenship law reform that would allow naturalization after three years in certain cases, calling it "flash naturalizations" and demanding closed borders and a "remigration offensive" instead.

q.o: Nicht nur aus Silvester hat die Ampelkoalition nichts gelernt. Ungeachtet der gravierenden Folgen der unkontrollierten Migration der vergangenen Jahre hält das Kabinett Scholz auch weiterhin daran fest, die Hürden für eine Einbürgerung deutlich abzusenken.
q.t: The traffic light coalition has learned nothing from New Year's Eve. Despite the serious consequences of uncontrolled migration in recent years, the Scholz cabinet continues to insist on significantly lowering the hurdles for naturalization.

q.o: Als AfD stellen wir uns deshalb nicht nur entschieden gegen jede Aufweichung der Einbürgerungspolitik, sondern fordern im Gegenteil eine Remigrationsoffensive. Die Grenzen müssen geschlossen und zügige Rückführungen all jener in Angriff genommen werden, die ausreisepflichtig sind.
q.t: As AfD, we therefore not only firmly oppose any softening of naturalization policy, but on the contrary demand a remigration offensive. The borders must be closed and swift deportations of all those who are obliged to leave must be undertaken.

s: Marine Le Pen is working to sanitize the Rassemblement National's image ahead of the 2027 elections with a focus on demonstrating governing capability.

La France insoumise and NUPES coalition announce a campaign against the government's pension reform that would raise retirement age to 64 or 65, organizing meetings including one on January 17 in Paris and proposing coordination with unions.

q.o: Les formations politiques de la NUPES s'opposent totalement à cette réforme injuste et inefficace, rejetée par une majorité de Français•es et toutes les organisations syndicales de salarié•es.
q.t: The political formations of NUPES totally oppose this unjust and ineffective reform, rejected by a majority of French people and all employee union organizations.

q.o: Ensemble, nous défendons notre système de retraite par répartition.
q.t: Together, we defend our pay-as-you-go pension system.

s: Vlaams Belang held its annual New Year's reception where party chairman Tom Van Grieken called Belgium a "failed state" and both he and MP Klaas Slootmans advocated for Flemish independence while criticizing the Vivaldi coalition government over drug violence and insecurity.

q.o: De realiteit is, anno 2023, dat de zogenaamde "volksfeesten" niet langer beperkt zijn tot Brussel en Antwerpen
q.t: The reality is, in 2023, that the so-called "popular festivals" are no longer limited to Brussels and Antwerp

q.o: Een vrije onafhankelijke staat waar wij als Vlamingen opnieuw baas zijn over onze eigen centen en grenzen. Waar wij als Vlamingen opnieuw baas kunnen zijn over onze eigen toekomst.
q.t: A free independent state where we as Flemings are once again in charge of our own money and borders. Where we as Flemings can once again be in charge of our own future.

q.o: De échte extremisten zijn de Vivaldi-partijen die een beleid voeren tégen de wil van de bevolking
q.t: The real extremists are the Vivaldi parties that pursue a policy against the will of the population

s: Vlaams Belang MEP Tom Vandendriessche responds to Frontex data showing 330,000 illegal border crossings in 2022 by calling for reception in migrants' own regions, loss of asylum rights for illegal entrants, and rejection of the EU Migration Pact.

q.o: Wie illegaal naar Europa komt, moet elk recht op asiel verliezen
q.t: Whoever comes to Europe illegally must lose every right to asylum

q.o: Europa is voor gelukszoekers het beloofde land. Door de jarenlange verwaarlozing van een streng asielbeleid, blijft de illegale instroom maar toenemen
q.t: Europe is the promised land for fortune seekers. Due to years of neglect of a strict asylum policy, the illegal influx continues to increase

q.o: Deze illegale invasie stoppen door meer legale routes te creëren, is zoals inbraak legaliseren omdat er te veel wordt ingebroken
q.t: Stopping this illegal invasion by creating more legal routes is like legalizing burglary because there are too many break-ins

q.o: Opvang moet per definitie in eigen regio gebeuren. Ontwikkelingshulp moet afhankelijk gemaakt worden van terugname van illegalen. De buitengrenzen moet juridisch en fysiek waterdicht worden gemaakt. Wie illegaal Europa binnenkomt, moet elk recht op asiel verliezen. NGO's die meewerken aan illegale migratie zijn criminele organisaties.
q.t: Reception must by definition take place in one's own region. Development aid must be made dependent on the return of illegals. The external borders must be made legally and physically watertight. Whoever enters Europe illegally must lose every right to asylum. NGOs that cooperate with illegal migration are criminal organizations.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Steven Creyelman criticizes Defense Minister Ludivine Dedonder for dismissing security concerns about Chinese materials discovered in F-35 fighter jet magnets and calls for improved security procedures in procurement policy.

q.o: Men heeft ongewenste Chinese materialen ontdekt in de magneten die nodig zijn voor de motoren van het toestel
q.t: Unwanted Chinese materials have been discovered in the magnets needed for the aircraft's engines

q.o: Dat brengt uiteraard veiligheidsrisico's met zich mee. Maar minister van Defensie Ludivine Dedonder (PS) kan niet eenvoudigweg alle verantwoordelijkheid op de VS afschuiven. De veiligheidsprocedures in ons aankoopbeleid moeten beter.
q.t: That obviously brings security risks with it. But Defense Minister Ludivine Dedonder (PS) cannot simply shift all responsibility to the US. The security procedures in our procurement policy must be better.

q.o: Het is niet het eerste en ook niet het laatste probleem dat we met de F-35's zullen zien
q.t: It is not the first and also not the last problem that we will see with the F-35s

s: Vlaams Belang criticizes the Belgian government for repatriating fifteen IS female fighters and subsequently releasing six of them conditionally or provisionally, demanding that terrorists be prosecuted in the regions where they committed their crimes rather than being allowed to return to Belgium.

q.o: Eerste minister Alexander De Croo (Open Vld) stelde steevast dat die operaties in het belang van de nationale veiligheid gebeurden omdat de vrouwen in kwestie op die manier niet van de radar zouden verdwijnen. Maar ondertussen lopen er al zes van hen vrij rond.
q.t: Prime Minister Alexander De Croo (Open Vld) consistently stated that these operations were carried out in the interest of national security because the women in question would not disappear from the radar in this way. But meanwhile, six of them are already walking around freely.

q.o: Het gaat stuk voor stuk om figuren die onze samenleving bewust de rug hebben toegekeerd en die wegtrokken naar Syrië of Irak om daar samen met Islamitische Staat het Westen te bevechten.
q.t: These are all figures who consciously turned their backs on our society and who left for Syria or Iraq to fight the West together with Islamic State.

q.o: Geen enkele IS-terrorist mag ooit nog een voet in dit land zetten.
q.t: No IS terrorist should ever set foot in this country again.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Stefaan Sintobin claims that Open Vld and CD&V now want to adjust the nitrogen agreement after sustained pressure from agricultural organizations and Vlaams Belang, stating that political support for the current agreement has completely disappeared.

q.o: Het is dankzij de aanhoudende druk van de landbouworganisaties en het Vlaams Belang dat deze twee regeringspartijen nu hun kar keren
q.t: It is thanks to the sustained pressure from agricultural organizations and Vlaams Belang that these two government parties are now changing course

q.o: Het ziet er naar uit dat het draagvlak voor het vorig jaar bereikte akkoord nu totaal weg is
q.t: It appears that the support for the agreement reached last year has now completely disappeared

q.o: Ik reken er ook op dat minister Demir haar conclusies trekt, het beleid nu eindelijk grondig bijstuurt en doet waar we al zo lang om vragen: het huidig akkoord in de prullenmand gooien en werk maken van een nieuw kader dat niet alleen rechtszekerheid biedt aan onze landbouwers, maar ook de levensvatbaarheid en de toekomst van de landbouwsector veilig stelt
q.t: I also count on Minister Demir to draw her conclusions, finally thoroughly adjust the policy and do what we have been asking for so long: throw the current agreement in the trash and work on a new framework that not only provides legal certainty to our farmers, but also safeguards the viability and future of the agricultural sector

s: Vlaams Belang MP Dries Van Langenhove demands the urgent evacuation of a squat in Schaarbeek housing up to 1,000 people including many undocumented migrants, citing safety and health concerns, and calls for their deportation or detention in closed facilities.

q.o: In het pand in kwestie deden zich al meermaals criminele feiten voor, en dan heb ik het nog niet eens over de ziektes die zich dreigen te verspreiden door het gebrek aan hygiëne aldaar
q.t: In the building in question, criminal acts have already occurred several times, and I'm not even talking about the diseases that threaten to spread due to the lack of hygiene there

q.o: Ondertussen is de situatie er al zodanig onveilig dat medewerkers van ngo's het gebouw niet eens meer willen betreden uit vrees voor hun leven of hun fysieke integriteit
q.t: Meanwhile, the situation there is already so unsafe that NGO workers no longer even want to enter the building for fear of their lives or their physical integrity

q.o: De illegalen in kwestie moeten terug naar het land van herkomst en in afwachting daarvan naar een gesloten instelling
q.t: The undocumented migrants in question must return to their country of origin and, pending that, to a closed facility

s: Vlaams Belang criticizes the federal Vivaldi government for missing a European Commission coronavirus recovery payment of 847 million euros due to an inadequate pension reform, blaming the PS party for blocking necessary reforms.

q.o: Dit uitstel dreigt weer maar eens een afstel te worden
q.t: This postponement threatens to become yet another cancellation

q.o: België heeft nu ook aan de Europese Commissie getoond dat dit land niet werkt. De PS loopt liever Europees geld mis dan dat ze ook maar één hervorming zou uitvoeren.
q.t: Belgium has now also shown the European Commission that this country does not work. The PS would rather miss out on European money than carry out even one reform.

q.o: De federale regering schuift de pensioenfactuur gewoon voor zich uit en komt niet met oplossingen met betrekking tot de betaalbaarheid en financiering van onze pensioenen.
q.t: The federal government simply pushes the pension bill ahead of itself and does not come up with solutions regarding the affordability and financing of our pensions.

s: Vlaams Belang launches a petition for military deployment against drug violence in Antwerp under 'Operation Hades', criticizing N-VA for only supporting the measure after an eleven-year-old girl was killed in a drug-related shooting.

q.o: Het is jammer dat er eerst een onschuldig kind moest sterven, vooraleer de partij van Bart De Wever ook tot dit inzicht komt
q.t: It is unfortunate that an innocent child first had to die before the party of Bart De Wever also comes to this insight

q.o: Wij pleiten hier met Operatie Hades al geruime tijd voor en hebben hiervoor een petitie gestart. Laten we hopen dat het momentum er nu wel is om de strijd tegen de drugsmaffia op te voeren.
q.t: We have been advocating for this with Operation Hades for quite some time and have started a petition for it. Let us hope that the momentum is now there to step up the fight against the drug mafia.

s: Vlaams Belang Duffel organized a book presentation event where Filip Dewinter presented his book titled 'Omvolking' (population replacement) on March 3, 2023.

q.o: Omvolking … werkelijkheid of mythe? Waarheid of leugen? Realiteit of complottheorie?
q.t: Population replacement … reality or myth? Truth or lie? Reality or conspiracy theory?

s: Vlaams Belang supports a union protest by Brussels emergency responders against violence, with party spokesperson Dominiek Lootens-Stael attributing attacks on emergency workers to a structural problem stemming from a total lack of integration by non-European foreigners.

q.o: Het loopt echt de spuigaten uit
q.t: It's really getting out of hand

q.o: De hulpverlening in bepaalde wijken komt in het gedrang.
q.t: Emergency services in certain neighborhoods are being compromised.

q.o: Brandweermannen getuigen vaak van aanvallen door niet-Europese vreemdelingen, blijkbaar uit onbegrip tegenover medische en andere noodprocedures.
q.t: Firefighters often testify to attacks by non-European foreigners, apparently due to incomprehension towards medical and other emergency procedures.

q.o: Het gaat hier echt over een structureel probleem dat voortvloeit uit een totaal gebrek aan integratie
q.t: This is really about a structural problem that stems from a total lack of integration

s: Vlaams Belang criticizes the Belgian government for conditionally releasing an IS terrorist who was later arrested in Hungary attempting to travel to Syria, demanding that IS members be prosecuted in the region where they committed crimes rather than repatriated.

q.o: Ze was, hoe kan het ook anders, in België vrijgelaten onder voorwaarden
q.t: She was, how could it be otherwise, released in Belgium under conditions

q.o: Het getuigt van een nauwelijks te vatten naïviteit om te denken dat wie onze vrije Westerse samenleving zo diep haat, eenvoudig tot inkeer zou kunnen komen en klaar zou zijn voor een voorwaardelijke vrijlating.
q.t: It shows a barely comprehensible naivety to think that those who hate our free Western society so deeply could simply repent and be ready for conditional release.

q.o: Het standpunt van het Vlaams Belang is in deze zeer duidelijk: IS-gangsters moeten berecht en bestraft worden in de regio waar ze zich aan hun gruwelijkheden hebben schuldig gemaakt
q.t: The position of Vlaams Belang is very clear on this: IS gangsters must be tried and punished in the region where they committed their atrocities

s: Vlaams Belang calls for convening the National Security Council after a deadly drug-related shooting in Antwerp killed an 11-year-old girl, with MP Ortwin Depoortere advocating for drastic intervention including possible military deployment and party leader Tom Van Grieken announcing he will question the Prime Minister in parliament.

q.o: De situatie is volledig geëscaleerd
q.t: The situation has completely escalated

q.o: Als er nu niet drastisch ingegrepen wordt, zullen er nog bijkomende slachtoffers vallen.
q.t: If drastic action is not taken now, there will be additional victims.

q.o: Dat het eerste dodelijke slachtoffer in het oplaaiende Antwerpse drugsgeweld een onschuldig kind is, maakt het des te tragischer
q.t: That the first fatal victim in the escalating Antwerp drug violence is an innocent child makes it all the more tragic

q.o: Er moet eindelijk echt actie ondernomen worden en desnoods moet het leger kunnen worden ingezet om de getroffen buurten te beschermen
q.t: Real action must finally be taken and if necessary the army must be able to be deployed to protect the affected neighborhoods

s: Vlaams Belang called for an early convening of the Antwerp city council after an eleven-year-old girl died in a shooting linked to drug violence in Merksem, demanding intensified action against drug crime including military assistance.

q.o: Het was helaas niet de vraag of, maar wanneer het drugsgeweld in Antwerpen dodelijke slachtoffers zou maken
q.t: Unfortunately it was not a question of if, but when the drug violence in Antwerp would claim deadly victims

q.o: Hopelijk doet dit spijtig dieptepunt iedereen, over de partijgrenzen heen, beseffen dat we een versnelling hoger moeten schakelen in de strijd tegen de drugsmaffia.
q.t: Hopefully this regrettable low point makes everyone, across party lines, realize that we must shift into higher gear in the fight against the drug mafia.

q.o: Iedereen over de partijgrenzen heen moet beseffen dat de strijd tegen de drugsmaffia in een hogere versnelling moet worden gebracht
q.t: Everyone across party lines must realize that the fight against the drug mafia must be brought into higher gear

s: Vlaams Belang MP Marijke Dillen criticizes Justice Minister Vincent Van Quickenborne for releasing dangerous criminals, citing a murder case and a rape by an African homeless man, and proposes that convicted foreign nationals serve sentences in their countries of origin.

q.o: Toen wegens de brutale verkrachting van een ULB-studente door een dakloze van Afrikaanse origine
q.t: Then because of the brutal rape of a ULB student by a homeless person of African origin

q.o: De overbevolking in de gevangenissen oplossen doe je niet door onveiligheid op straat te creëren, maar door veroordeelden hun straffen te laten uitzitten in hun land van herkomst.
q.t: You don't solve prison overcrowding by creating insecurity on the streets, but by having convicts serve their sentences in their country of origin.

s: Prime Minister Sanna Marin stated that the Finns Party is openly racist.
Avi Maoz of Noam party received government approval to take partial control of Israeli education.
Left-wing Israelis protested in the streets in response to the new right-wing government's agenda in January 2023.
Ayman Odeh accused Yair Lapid's government of killing 114 Palestinians.
MeRA25 criticizes Greek oligarchs and business leaders for celebrating economic prospects while citizens deplete savings and questions what wage increases they will give to workers.

q.o: 500 εκατ. ευρώ αποταμιεύσεων "σηκώθηκαν", μέσα σε ένα μήνα, για καθημερινές ανάγκες.
q.t: 500 million euros of savings were withdrawn within one month for daily needs.

q.o: Στους εργαζόμενούς τους, τι αυξήσεις θα δώσουν;
q.t: What wage increases will they give to their employees?

s: AfD federal board member Carlo Clemens supports a migrant quota for schools and classes, citing integration problems and lack of German language skills, and calls on Minister Feller to present a concept for more even distribution of integration burdens.

q.o: Herr Meidinger spricht den berühmten Elefanten im Raum an. Die Bildungsforschung weist klar auf den Zusammenhang hin zwischen der zunehmend heterogener werdenden Zusammensetzung der Schülerschaft und Benachteiligungen, insbesondere für lernstarke und lernschwache Schüler. Hinzu kommen oftmals kulturell bedingte Integrationsprobleme und fehlende Deutschkenntnisse.
q.t: Mr. Meidinger addresses the famous elephant in the room. Educational research clearly points to the connection between the increasingly heterogeneous composition of the student body and disadvantages, especially for high-performing and low-performing students. In addition, there are often culturally-related integration problems and lack of German language skills.

q.o: Eine Obergrenze für Schulen und Klassen wäre daher sowohl für Lehrkräfte als auch für Schüler dienlich.
q.t: An upper limit for schools and classes would therefore be beneficial for both teachers and students.

q.o: Ministerin Feller muss unverzüglich handeln und ein Konzept vorlegen, wie eine gleichmäßigere Verteilung der Integrationslasten durch eine Migrationsquote realisiert werden kann.
q.t: Minister Feller must act immediately and present a concept for how a more even distribution of integration burdens can be realized through a migration quota.

s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the planned delivery of American Bradley fighting vehicles and French reconnaissance tanks to Ukraine, calling it crossing a red line and demanding the German government pursue de-escalation and investigate the Nord Stream attack.

q.o: Mit dieser Lieferung von Kampfpanzern überschreiten unsere NATO-Partner eine weitere rote Linie. Russland könnte weitere Truppen mobilisieren und noch schwerere Waffen in der Ukraine einsetzen. Friedensverhandlungen statt Eskalation wären der richtige Weg.
q.t: With this delivery of battle tanks, our NATO partners are crossing another red line. Russia could mobilize additional troops and deploy even heavier weapons in Ukraine. Peace negotiations instead of escalation would be the right path.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung muss deeskalierend auf die USA und Frankreich einwirken. Deutsche Interessen müssen an erster Stelle stehen. Dazu gehört auch, endlich die Täter und Hintergründe des Anschlags auf Nord Stream aufzuklären.
q.t: The federal government must exert a de-escalating influence on the USA and France. German interests must come first. This also includes finally clarifying the perpetrators and background of the attack on Nord Stream.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner calls for harsh state action against young migrants following New Year's Eve incidents, accusing them of rejecting German values and society.

q.o: Unintegrierte junge Männer mit Migrationshintergrund stellen unsere Gesellschaft seit Jahren auf eine schwere Probe. Es ist an der Zeit, dieses Problem, das es im Übrigen nicht nur zu Silvester und in Deutschland gibt, offen zu benennen und vor allem zu lösen.
q.t: Unintegrated young men with a migration background have been putting our society to a severe test for years. It is time to openly name this problem, which incidentally exists not only on New Year's Eve and in Germany, and above all to solve it.

q.o: Egal ob Randale im Schwimmbad oder Messerstechereien am Wochenende: immer wieder tauchen junge Migranten als Täter auf, die unsere Werte ablehnen, unsere Gesellschaft verachten. Als AfD fordern wir ein hartes Durchgreifen des Staates, denn nur ein konsequenter und durchgreifender Staat ist in der Lage sich Respekt zu verschaffen.
q.t: Whether it's riots in the swimming pool or stabbings on the weekend: again and again young migrants appear as perpetrators who reject our values and despise our society. As AfD we demand harsh state action, because only a consistent and forceful state is able to gain respect.

s: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticized SPD Interior Minister Pistorius for allegedly deflecting from migrant perpetrators of New Year's Eve riots, blamed unregulated mass immigration since 2015 for crime and terrorism, and stated the AfD would clearly name problems if it comes to government responsibility in 2024.

q.o: Wer mit offenen Augen durchs Leben läuft, die zahllosen Videos von der Silvesternacht gesehen und das migrantische Milieu bei der Randale beobachten konnte, wird von allen politischen Seiten angegriffen, man sei fremdenfeindlich.
q.t: Anyone who walks through life with open eyes, has seen the countless videos from New Year's Eve and could observe the migrant milieu in the riots, is attacked from all political sides as being xenophobic.

q.o: Die desaströsen Folgen der unregulierten Massenzuwanderung seit 2015 sind jedoch unübersehbar und verschärfen sich weiter: überproportionale Zuwandererkriminalität, Terroranschläge und islamischer Separatismus belegen dies ebenso wie dreistellige Milliardenkosten, Wohnraummangel und die hohe Arbeitslosigkeit unter den Zuwanderern.
q.t: The disastrous consequences of unregulated mass immigration since 2015 are unmistakable and continue to worsen: disproportionate immigrant crime, terrorist attacks and Islamic separatism demonstrate this, as do three-digit billion costs, housing shortages and high unemployment among immigrants.

q.o: Kommt die AfD in Regierungsverantwortung, die ich in 2024 für absolut realistisch halte, werden wir nicht wie die öffentlich-rechtlichen Medien und die Politik wegsehen, sondern die Probleme klar benennen.
q.t: When the AfD comes into government responsibility, which I consider absolutely realistic in 2024, we will not look away like the public broadcasters and politicians, but will clearly name the problems.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner calls for securing borders, consistent punishment, and deportation of migrants following New Year's Eve violence in Berlin, criticizing discussions of fireworks bans instead of immigration control measures.

q.o: Zunächst einmal müssen Ross und Reiter beim Namen genannt werden: Solange Politik und Medien versuchen, den Begriff ‚Migrant' bei der Analyse der Vorgänge in der Silvesternacht zu vermeiden, ist es unmöglich, entschieden gegen die vorherrschenden Probleme in unserem Land vorzugehen.
q.t: First of all, we must call a spade a spade: As long as politics and media try to avoid the term 'migrant' when analyzing the events of New Year's Eve, it is impossible to take decisive action against the prevailing problems in our country.

q.o: Endlich müssen wir klar machen, dass die Menschen, die als Schutzsuchende in unser Land kamen und nun ihre volle Verachtung gegenüber unseren Traditionen und Werten verdeutlichen sowie straffällig werden, nichts in Deutschland zu suchen haben!
q.t: Finally, we must make it clear that people who came to our country as asylum seekers and now demonstrate their complete contempt for our traditions and values and become criminals have no place in Germany!

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Peter Boehringer criticizes FDP Finance Minister Lindner for withdrawing tax reduction proposals under pressure from SPD and Greens, arguing that tax relief is urgently needed during inflation and that the FDP achieves nothing in the coalition that does not align with Green party wishes.

q.o: In Zeiten, in denen die Inflation den Lebensstandard der Menschen auffrisst, sind steuerliche Entlastungen das Gebot der Stunde.
q.t: In times when inflation is eating away at people's standard of living, tax relief is the order of the day.

q.o: Für viele hoch ideologische, oftmals sogar kontraproduktive und gegen Deutschland gerichteten Projekte scheint Geld vorhanden zu sein, nicht jedoch für die deutschen Steuerzahler.
q.t: For many highly ideological, often even counterproductive and anti-German projects, money seems to be available, but not for German taxpayers.

q.o: Die FDP müsste nämlich langsam erkennen, dass für sie in der Ampelkoalition rein gar nichts ‚erreichbar' ist, was nicht dem Willen der Grünen entspricht.
q.t: The FDP should slowly recognize that nothing at all is 'achievable' for them in the traffic light coalition that does not correspond to the will of the Greens.

s: La France insoumise announced its coordination structure on January 3, 2023, with Manuel Bompard designated as coordinator, and declared total opposition to the government's pension reform with plans for mobilization including a march on January 21.

q.o: Alors que la première ministre Élisabeth Borne présentera le projet de loi du gouvernement sur les retraites le 10 janvier, nous rappelons notre opposition totale à cette réforme et notre volonté d'une mobilisation la plus large possible pour en obtenir le retrait.
q.t: While Prime Minister Élisabeth Borne will present the government's pension reform bill on January 10, we recall our total opposition to this reform and our desire for the broadest possible mobilization to obtain its withdrawal.

q.o: A l'unanimité, Manuel Bompard en a été désigné coordinateur, dans la continuité du travail engagé depuis plusieurs mois, et en lien étroit avec Mathilde Panot, présidente de groupe à l'Assemblée Nationale et Manon Aubry, présidente de groupe au Parlement européen.
q.t: Unanimously, Manuel Bompard was designated as coordinator, in continuity with the work undertaken for several months, and in close connection with Mathilde Panot, group president in the National Assembly and Manon Aubry, group president in the European Parliament.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Ortwin Depoortere responded to the arrest of an Iranian man in Germany for planning a biological weapon attack, calling for vigilance against new terrorist methods and linking the threat to lax migration policy.

q.o: We moeten alert blijven voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe methodes om aanslagen te plegen
q.t: We must remain alert to the development of new methods to commit attacks

q.o: Ook in ons land is het risico op islamistisch terrorisme zeker niet verminderd.
q.t: In our country too, the risk of Islamist terrorism has certainly not diminished.

q.o: Ook in ons land zullen we alert moeten blijven en ons moeten aanpassen aan nieuwe werkwijzen van terroristen.
q.t: In our country too, we will have to remain alert and adapt to new methods of terrorists.

q.o: Het gevaar is allerminst geweken en blijft mee gefaciliteerd worden door de lakse houding ten aanzien van migratie.
q.t: The danger has by no means disappeared and continues to be facilitated by the lax attitude towards migration.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Ellen Samyn criticizes the Belgian government for ignoring persecution of Christians in Islamic countries, particularly Nigeria, and calls for cutting development aid to countries that do not protect religious minorities.

q.o: Wij kaarten dit mensenrechtendossier al jaren aan in het parlement, maar de paars-groene excellenties blijven hier doof en blind voor
q.t: We have been raising this human rights dossier in parliament for years, but the purple-green excellencies remain deaf and blind to it

q.o: Hoewel ze luidkeels toeteren over discriminatie tegen moslims, blijven ze muisstil wanneer christenen omwille van hun geloof worden aangevallen. Schrijnend hypocriet.
q.t: Although they loudly trumpet about discrimination against Muslims, they remain silent when Christians are attacked because of their faith. Painfully hypocritical.

q.o: Wanneer men de rechten van religieuze minderheden niet wil of kan beschermen, mag men geen ontwikkelingsgeld ontvangen.
q.t: When one does not want to or cannot protect the rights of religious minorities, one should not receive development aid.

s: Vlaams Belang MP Ortwin Depoortere criticized the 2016 Brussels terror attacks trial after secret security information about surveillance of terror suspects was read aloud in court, calling the proceedings increasingly farcical and dangerous for police officers.

q.o: Dit proces begint meer en meer op een klucht te lijken
q.t: This trial is beginning to look more and more like a farce

q.o: De terroristen slagen er zo in van onze rechtstaat een lachertje te maken
q.t: The terrorists are thus succeeding in making a mockery of our rule of law

q.o: Terroristen van over heel de wereld kunnen met deze informatie aan de slag
q.t: Terrorists from all over the world can use this information

q.o: Nu worden ze niet geconfronteerd met een proces, maar met de spelletjes van terroristen en hun advocaten
q.t: Now they are not confronted with a trial, but with the games of terrorists and their lawyers

s: Vlaams Belang criticizes Justice Minister Van Quickenborne's lenient policy after a student was raped by a previously convicted man of African origin who they argue should have been in prison.

q.o: Die man had in de gevangenis moeten zitten
q.t: That man should have been in prison

q.o: Weer een verschrikkelijk menselijk drama dat zich in een rechtstaat, die naam waardig, nooit zou hebben afgespeeld.
q.t: Again a terrible human drama that would never have occurred in a rule of law worthy of that name.

q.o: Verkrachtingen gebeuren in dit land met de regelmaat van een klok, een afdoende bestraffing ervan kent die regelmaat niet
q.t: Rapes happen in this country with the regularity of a clock, adequate punishment for them does not have that regularity

q.o: De studente is niet alleen het slachtoffer geworden van moorddadig gespuis dat eind december uiteraard niet vrij had mogen rondlopen
q.t: The student has not only become the victim of murderous scum who obviously should not have been allowed to walk free at the end of December

q.o: Ze is evenzeer het slachtoffer van het linkse, uiterst lakse beleid van Van Quickenborne
q.t: She is equally the victim of Van Quickenborne's leftist, extremely lax policy

s: Alexander Van Hoecke is appointed as the new press officer of Vlaams Belang, replacing Jonas Naeyaert who will take on a coordinating role within the party's communication service.

q.o: Ik begin met heel veel enthousiasme aan mijn nieuwe functie. Ik kijk ernaar uit om mee te kunnen werken aan de communicatie van onze partij en bouw verder op het indrukwekkende werk van mijn voorganger. Naarmate de verkiezingen dichterbij komen hoop ik ook een bijdrage te kunnen leveren aan onze missie om de grootste partij van Vlaanderen te worden en uiteindelijk het beleid mee vorm te geven vanuit de regering.
q.t: I begin my new function with great enthusiasm. I look forward to being able to work on the communication of our party and build further on the impressive work of my predecessor. As the elections approach, I also hope to be able to contribute to our mission to become the largest party in Flanders and ultimately help shape policy from the government.

q.o: We hebben deze legislatuur volop ingezet op het aanwerven van nieuw capabel personeel. Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat Alexander ook in deze positie een nuttige bijdrage zal kunnen leveren voor de partij. Deze aanstelling past binnen ons streven naar professionalisering en onze 'missie 2024'.
q.t: We have fully committed this legislature to recruiting new capable personnel. I am convinced that Alexander will also be able to make a useful contribution to the party in this position. This appointment fits within our pursuit of professionalization and our 'mission 2024'.

s: Vlaams Belang criticizes Iran's conviction of Flemish aid worker Olivier Vandecasteele for alleged espionage, calling it a deliberate tactic to blackmail Europeans and demanding a radical shift in relations with Iran.

q.o: Het islamitische regime wil op die manier Europeanen gebruiken om ons te chanteren
q.t: The Islamic regime wants to use Europeans in this way to blackmail us

q.o: De enige manier om dit te stoppen is een radicale ommezwaai in onze relaties met Iran
q.t: The only way to stop this is a radical shift in our relations with Iran

q.o: Het is niet de eerste keer dat Iran valselijke beschuldigingen uit over individuen om Europese landen onder druk te zetten
q.t: It is not the first time that Iran makes false accusations about individuals to put pressure on European countries

q.o: Het islamitische regime gebruikt dit als een doelbewuste tactiek om bepaalde doelen te bereiken
q.t: The Islamic regime uses this as a deliberate tactic to achieve certain goals

q.o: Het is tijd voor een radicale ommezwaai in onze relatie met het land
q.t: It is time for a radical shift in our relationship with the country

s: Vlaams Belang submits resolutions in multiple Belgian parliaments demanding stricter measures against female genital mutilation, including lifetime professional bans for medical personnel who assist, citing 23,395 affected women and girls in Belgium and linking the practice to Islamic traditions.

q.o: Deze vorm van verminking en foltering leidt zo goed als nooit tot enige vervolging of bestraffing
q.t: This form of mutilation and torture almost never leads to any prosecution or punishment

q.o: Door de toenemende migratie komt dit ook meer en meer in het Westen, ook in Vlaanderen, voor.
q.t: Due to increasing migration, this is also occurring more and more in the West, including in Flanders.

q.o: Een belangrijk motief is volgens sommige moslims ook dat het volgens een hadith (overleveringen van uitspraken van de profeet Mohammed) 'sunna' is om je dochters te laten besnijden. Dat betekent dat het 'voorbeeldig gedrag volgens de profeet' is.
q.t: An important motive according to some Muslims is also that according to a hadith (traditions of statements by the prophet Mohammed) it is 'sunna' to have your daughters circumcised. That means it is 'exemplary behavior according to the prophet'.

q.o: Artsen en medisch personeel die meewerken aan genitale verminking moeten een levenslang beroepsverbod kunnen krijgen
q.t: Doctors and medical personnel who cooperate in genital mutilation must be able to receive a lifetime professional ban

s: Vlaams Belang Burcht-Zwijndrecht organized a New Year's reception on February 5, 2023, where Filip Dewinter presented his book 'Omvolking' (Great Replacement).

Vlaams Belang politicians Barbara Pas and Marijke Dillen criticize language-change procedures in the Halle-Vilvoorde judicial district, claiming they create traffic safety risks and are a consequence of "Francophone imperialism," arguing only Flemish independence can resolve the issue.

q.o: Die gevaarlijke verkeerssituaties zijn het directe gevolg van het Franstalige imperialisme in Halle Vilvoorde
q.t: Those dangerous traffic situations are the direct consequence of Francophone imperialism in Halle Vilvoorde

q.o: Maar helaas is dit probleem in Belgisch staatsverband zo goed als onoplosbaar. Alleen in een onafhankelijk Vlaanderen kunnen we dat terug rechttrekken.
q.t: But unfortunately this problem is virtually unsolvable within the Belgian state structure. Only in an independent Flanders can we rectify that.

q.o: Zolang België bestaat is dit probleem spijtig genoeg zo goed als onoplosbaar en zal het Franstalig imperialisme - letterlijk - zijn slachtoffers blijven eisen. Alleen in een onafhankelijk Vlaanderen kunnen we deze levensgevaarlijke absurditeiten stoppen.
q.t: As long as Belgium exists this problem is unfortunately virtually unsolvable and Francophone imperialism will - literally - continue to claim its victims. Only in an independent Flanders can we stop these life-threatening absurdities.

s: Vlaams Belang calls for Belgium to end negotiations on the nuclear accord with Iran and halt the extradition treaty, citing new Iranian measures enforcing mandatory hijab wearing as evidence that the regime has not changed despite protests following Mahsa Amini's death.

q.o: Teheran scherpt de repressieve islamitische kledingvoorschriften vandaag nog verder aan
q.t: Tehran is further tightening the repressive Islamic dress codes today

q.o: We moeten de onderhandelingen over het nucleair akkoord definitief opbergen en het uitleveringsverdrag stopzetten
q.t: We must definitively shelve the negotiations on the nuclear accord and stop the extradition treaty

q.o: Het gaat van de regen in de drop met deze islamitische dictatuur, ondanks de westerse pogingen om de nucleaire deal te herstarten en het Belgisch-Iraanse uitleveringsverdrag
q.t: It's going from bad to worse with this Islamic dictatorship, despite Western attempts to restart the nuclear deal and the Belgian-Iranian extradition treaty

s: Vlaams Belang MP Filip Brusselmans criticized left-wing parties for opposing a Flemish identity documentary series, claiming the left denies identity exists except when it concerns Palestinians or gender politics.

q.o: Voor links bestaat identiteit niet, behalve als het om Palestijnen of genderpolitiek gaat.
q.t: For the left, identity does not exist, except when it concerns Palestinians or gender politics.

s: Vlaams Belang opposes a general fireworks ban as a solution to New Year's riots, instead demanding zero-tolerance policies, fast-track justice, and harsh punishment for rioters who attack police and emergency workers, explicitly describing the perpetrators as predominantly allochtone (immigrant-origin) troublemakers.

q.o: Het gaat steevast om overwegend allochtone relschoppers die elke gelegenheid te baat nemen om te vernielen, te roven en te plunderen.
q.t: It consistently involves predominantly allochtone rioters who seize every opportunity to destroy, rob and plunder.

q.o: Wat het Vlaams Belang betreft is het tijd voor een harde aanpak. Geen paars-groene knipoogjes, schouderklopjes of kushandjes meer, maar zerotolerantie, meer preventieve huisverboden, arrestaties van iedere relschopper zonder onderscheid en snelrecht met extra zware bestraffing van geweld tegen politiemensen en hulpverleners.
q.t: As far as Vlaams Belang is concerned, it is time for a tough approach. No more purple-green winks, pats on the back or blown kisses, but zero tolerance, more preventive house bans, arrests of every rioter without distinction and fast-track justice with extra severe punishment for violence against police officers and aid workers.

s: Sweden assumes the EU presidency while pursuing an anti-immigrant course, with the Sweden Democrats' influence noted in the context of the country's migration policy stance.
MP Wille Rydman announced he will join the Finns Party.
Giorgia Meloni's government in Italy is targeting NGOs that rescue migrants at sea.

A literary publication examines how Mussolini's legacy continues to influence contemporary Italian public and private life, with implicit relevance to Brothers of Italy given the party's historical connections to Italian fascism.
An article discusses potential political pressure from Nigel Farage and his political approach on Conservative Prime Minister Rishi Sunak.
Reform UK leader Richard Tice stated his ambition to eliminate the Conservative Party at the polls.
Reform UK leader Richard Tice mocked Prime Minister Rishi Sunak's new pledge and claimed that Reform UK's surge in polling has worried the Conservative Party.
National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir restricted visits by Israeli lawmakers to security prisoners.
Zvika Fogel, associated with Otzma Yehudit, made public statements that are characterized as revealing previously unspoken positions.
A Saudi official stated that Saudi-Israel normalisation is not possible while Itamar Ben-Gvir holds office in the Israeli government.
An Otzma Yehudit MK stated that party leader Ben Gvir consulted with rabbis and security officials regarding an unspecified matter.
Itamar Ben-Gvir visited the Temple Mount in an early notable move, reportedly against Prime Minister Netanyahu's urging.
Itamar Ben-Gvir visited the contested Jerusalem holy site (Temple Mount/Al-Aqsa compound) despite warnings, marking his first visit since the election.

s: An ultranationalist Israeli minister from Otzma Yehudit visited the Jerusalem holy site, an action typically associated with provocative political statements regarding Israeli sovereignty over contested religious areas.
A far-right Israeli minister from Otzma Yehudit visited a contested holy site in Jerusalem, provoking Palestinian anger.
MeRA25 proposes withdrawal from the Israel-Cyprus-Egypt axis as part of its independent foreign policy platform.

q.o: Απόσυρση από τον Άξονα Ισραήλ-Κύπρος-Αίγυπτος
q.t: Withdrawal from the Israel-Cyprus-Egypt Axis

s: Vlaams Belang politicians Depoortere and De Brabandere called for year-round harsh measures against rioters following New Year's Eve disturbances in Brussels and Antwerp, characterizing the perpetrators as immigrant youth and demanding arrests, prosecutions, blacklisting of repeat offenders, and loss of child benefits.

q.o: Er zijn nog zekerheden in het leven, de oudejaarsavondrellen zijn daar één van
q.t: There are still certainties in life, the New Year's Eve riots are one of them

q.o: Opnieuw waren vooral Brussel en Antwerpen de slagvelden. We herhalen ons pleidooi voor een strenge aanpak van de relschoppers. Niet alleen op 31 december, maar het hele jaar door.
q.t: Once again Brussels and Antwerp were especially the battlefields. We repeat our plea for a strict approach to the rioters. Not only on December 31, but all year round.

q.o: Als we dit niet elke jaarwisseling willen meemaken, moet er eindelijk werk gemaakt worden van een harde aanpak. Niet alleen op 31 december, maar van 1 januari tot 31 december, 365 dagen per jaar.
q.t: If we don't want to experience this every New Year, we must finally get to work on a tough approach. Not only on December 31, but from January 1 to December 31, 365 days a year.

q.o: Net zoals bij de rellen na de voetbalwedstrijden van Marokko dient ook nu, zonder onderscheid, elke relschopper of vandaal opgepakt te worden, opgesloten en vervolgd met snelrecht
q.t: Just as with the riots after Morocco's football matches, now too, without distinction, every rioter or vandal must be arrested, locked up and prosecuted with fast-track justice

q.o: Recidiverende relschoppers moeten op een zwarte lijst en dienen hun kindergeld te verliezen.
q.t: Repeat rioters must be put on a blacklist and should lose their child benefits.

s: A far-right Israeli lawmaker from Otzma Yehudit responded to a UN vote by declaring that the occupation is now permanent.

q.o: As of now, the occupation is permanent
q.t: As of now, the occupation is permanent
